title: Expanded-equivalence classes of type-II Generalised Feistel Networks
summary: Determine the number and sizes of expanded-equivalence classes when all branch permutations of a type-II GFN are allowed.

formal_statement.body: For branch permutations $P,Q\in S_{2k}$, define expanded equivalence by the existence of a pair relabelling $A$ such that $Q^nAP^{-n}$ is a pair relabelling for every positive integer $n$. Determine the number and cardinality of equivalence classes when $P,Q$ range over all $S_{2k}$.

scope.domain: Equivalence and relabelling of type-II Generalised Feistel Networks
assumptions: Pair relabellings use the source convention
scope.unresolved_remainder: The record concerns expanded equivalence, not cryptanalytic security or implementation cost.

citations.label: Derbez--Euler, Equivalence of Generalised Feistel Networks

progress.summary: The source paper proves a sharp result for the even--odd subfamily and asks for the all-permutation case.
